description: Bus Timings is a dataset listed in Ajmandata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Transport Authority. Ajman Transportation Authority bus timings, line name, leaving area, bus numbers and timings. Coverage: Ajman emirate. The portal files it under Transport and infrastructure. The portal shows 158 records. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ajman-ae-portal.
